params.1273: Equip a ranged weapon to fight enemies from a distance.
params.1274: Open your inventory by clicking the backpack icon, then click on your sling to wield it.
params.1275: (If you don't have a sling, you can buy equipment in the combat area.)
params.1276: You can view your equipped sling in the Worn Equipment screen. If you want to unequip it, click on it there.
params.2225:
Some ranged weapons (such as bows) require ammunition as well.

You can also equip melee weapons in the same way, by clicking on them from your inventory.
